title: Says Nanak, The Divine Light Has Dawned
summary: The shabad does not leave fear at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind
lifeApplication: Read the line until fear is no longer the loudest narrator in the room. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
